native.kind: source market kind (on-demand, secure, spot, community, ...)
native.usd_per_gpu_hour: source price already normalized to USD per GPU-hour
native.venue_grade: source venue class; present in the rows but not used by the landscape

derived.card: card display name mapped from series through the card catalog
derived.card_id: card catalog id mapped from series
derived.vram_gb: card catalog memory size; the source row's vramGb is not used to split cards
derived.market_label: market display label mapped from kind
derived.risk: market risk label mapped from kind
derived.quotes: count of same-day source rows behind the provider value
derived.source_layer: 'own' for every row in this dataset; external reference layers are published separately
derived.median: median of same-day per-provider medians; one provider one vote
derived.p25_p75: quartiles of same-day provider medians; null below 4 providers
derived.cheapest: minimum raw same-day quote before per-provider aggregation
derived.cheapest_series: one daily minimum raw quote with its provider and source URL
derived.monthly: fixed-panel monthly summary from daily on-demand quotes; see definitions.monthly
derived.status: live/unconfirmed/stopped derived from quote age against the data as-of
derived.change_7d_pct (market): market-level change against the last reading at or before as-of minus 7 days
derived.last_confirmed_at: quote date used as a confirmation proxy; the source has no per-row confirmation timestamp
derived.listed_currency: 'USD' declared because the source dataset is already normalized to USD
derived.fx_rate: 1.0 sentinel because no per-row FX conversion is retained
derived.listed_unit: 'USD/GPU-hour', the unit of the normalized source price

unavailable.region: null: source rows carry no region dimension
unavailable.gpu_count: null: source rows carry no GPU count and the node-to-GPU normalization cannot be re-derived
unavailable.listed_price: null: only the normalized per-GPU price is retained, not the original listing price
unavailable.fx_date: null: no per-row FX date exists
unavailable.scraped_at: null: only a dataset-level fetchedAt exists, not a per-row scrape time
unavailable.listed_since: null: source rows have no first-listed date
unavailable.source_kind: null: source rows have no source-kind field (venueGrade is not equivalent)
unavailable.change_7d_pct (per quote): null: no per-quote 7-day history is retained; only the market-level change is derived

definitions.on_demand: kinds on-demand and secure; community, spot, reserved, marketplace and serverless excluded from this median
definitions.median: each provider once per day; median across providers
definitions.p25_p75: quartiles across provider medians; omitted when fewer than 4 providers
definitions.status: live if within 2 days of data as-of; unconfirmed within 7 days; stopped otherwise. Stopped markets keep their last reading and are still used for daily medians and cheapest values; the weekly index only includes readings confirmed within 2 days of the week's last day.
definitions.vintage: provisional for the current ISO week; final after the week closes
definitions.index: published at >=8 confirmed providers; thin at 4-7; withheld below 4; only the provider's latest day in the week, confirmed within 2 days of the week's last day
definitions.receipts: public price-index.json and per-card slices retain the latest published week only; full history stays in tracker_data
definitions.monthly: calendar month UTC; panel fixed before the month starts from providers with on-demand quotes on >=13 of the 14 days immediately before the month starts (month_start - 14 days through month_start - 1 day); value is the arithmetic mean of daily median-of-panel-provider-medians over days with >=8 panel providers; published at >=75% valid-day coverage and >=8 panel providers, withheld otherwise; vintage is provisional for the month containing the data as-of and final for earlier months; a daily-frequency approximation, not an hourly panel
definitions.cheapest_series: one point per day: the minimum raw quoted USD/GPU-hour among that day's quotes, with the provider and source URL of that quote; not a provider median and not the market median
definitions.risk: low for on-demand/reserved; medium for serverless/shared; high for spot/community/marketplace floor
definitions.price_scope: rate_card is a listed rate normalized to one GPU; instance vs GPU-only scope is not retained in this version; marketplace_floor and serverless are separate

gpueconomy.role: secondary reference layer; own medians, provider counts and index are unchanged
